user.title: Surf spot
user.description: Name and position of your spot. Place the pin on the water just off the beach.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Define what surfable means for you. An hour counts when all conditions hold; consecutive hours form a session.

data.use_swell: Use swell instead of total wave height
data.glassy_max: Below this wind speed the direction does not matter

data_description.wind_dir_from: Direction the wind comes FROM (0 = N, 90 = E). Clockwise from → to, e.g. 90 → 200 for offshore at a west-facing beach.
data_description.swell_dir_from: Direction the swell comes from, clockwise from → to.
data_description.notify_service: Leave empty if you only use the surf_forecast_session event / blueprint.

error.no_marine_data: No wave data for this location. Move the pin a bit further out to sea.
error.wave_range: Maximum wave height must be greater than the minimum.
error.corridor_incomplete: Set both corridor bounds or both to -1.
error.notify_service: The service must start with notify.
